item.description: China’s newly released supplementary reading for the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee offers a clear window into the priorities that will shape next year’s 21st Communist Party congress. item.title: Sky’s the limit: Chinese woman pilot rises to airline captain decade after historic flight
item.description: Chinese pilot Wang Zheng has been promoted to captain at American Airlines, 10 years after being widely recognised as the first Asian woman to fly solo around the world. “From the solitary courage of flying solo around the world in a single-engine aircraft a decade ago, to putting on the four stripes and taking on the responsibility of an American Airlines captain today – this is a route I’ve flown for half a lifetime,” Wang wrote in a post on microblogging platform Weibo on Thursday. item.title: Belgium orders Google to stop work on data centre lacking proper permits
item.description: Belgian authorities have ordered Google to suspend construction of a data centre in the south of the country because of a lack of proper planning permission, a regional official said on Friday. “We have identified a major offence: the illegal construction of a building covering three hectares (7 acres),” said Nicolas Yernaux, spokesman for the Wallonia regional authorities. item.title: China test-fires world’s first metal powder-fuelled afterburner for fighter jets
item.description: Metal powder may seem an unlikely fuel for a jet engine, but Chinese scientists believe it could help propel planes to greater speeds. A research team in eastern China has successfully conducted ground tests for a prototype turbojet engine that burns metal powder in its afterburner instead of kerosene, in what the state-run Science and Technology Daily described as a “world first” on Thursday.
